companion_plan_scope: Companion activation plan for active scripts, prompts, workflows, and agent targets. `squad plugin dry-run` separately shows the complete versioned distribution under templates/squad-heroes/companion/ without directly targeting active consumer paths.
dry_run_complete: Dry run complete. No files were changed.
external_approval_required: Externally visible actions require explicit confirmation.
fallback_visible: Translation uses language {language} as a visible fallback.
model_catalog_fallback: Copilot model discovery is unavailable; using the verified fallback model menu.
picker_help: ↑/↓ or j/k to move, Enter to confirm, Escape or q to cancel
picker_cancelled: Selection cancelled; no changes were made.
picker_tty_required: Interactive selection requires a TTY. For noninteractive use pass the installation flags, including --model-reqeng, --model-work, --model-review, and --project-number when board sync is enabled.
github_access_verified: GitHub host authentication, repository permissions, Project scope, and non-mutating Project API access verified for {account}. Safe scope status: project granted.
gh_cli_missing: GitHub preflight failed. Host: {host}. Active gh account: unavailable. `gh` is missing. Install GitHub CLI, then run `gh auth login --hostname github.com --web` and retry. Verification begins with `gh auth status --hostname github.com`. No mutation started.
gh_auth_failed: GitHub authentication failed. Host: {host}. Active gh account: unavailable. Repository: {repository}. Result: {summary}. Run `gh auth status --hostname github.com`, then `gh auth login --hostname github.com --web` and complete the browser/device flow. No token is accepted or printed. No mutation started.
gh_repository_not_found: Repository check failed. Host: {host}. Active gh account: {active}. Repository: {repository}. Verification: `gh api repos/{repository} --jq .permissions` → {summary}. The repository may be missing, or this account may not see a private repository. Run `gh repo view {repository}`; ask an authenticated owner to verify that it exists and that this account has collaborator access. No mutation started.
gh_repository_read_denied: Repository read access was not granted. Host: {host}. Active gh account: {active}. Repository: {repository}. Permissions: {permissions}. Verification: `gh api repos/{repository} --jq .permissions`. Run `gh repo view {repository}` and ask an authenticated owner to grant this account read or collaborator access. The account does not need to be the repository owner. No mutation started.
gh_repository_push_denied: Repository is readable, but push access is false. Host: {host}. Active gh account: {active}. Repository: {repository}. Permissions: {permissions}. Verification: `gh api repos/{repository} --jq .permissions`. Check `gh api user --jq .login`; ask an owner or maintainer to grant this account write or collaborator access. The account does not need to be the repository owner. No mutation started.
gh_account_mismatch: GitHub account mismatch. Host: {host}. Active gh account: {active}. Expected account: {expected}. Repository: {repository}. If expected account `{expected}` is already configured, run `gh auth switch --hostname github.com --user {expected}`; otherwise run `gh auth login --hostname github.com --web` and select that identity. Then rerun `gh api user --jq .login`. Collaborator access is valid; owner equality is not required. No mutation started.
gh_account_invalid: Expected GitHub account is not a safe public login. Active gh account: {active}. Check `gh api user --jq .login` and supply a valid expected account. No mutation started.
gh_api_error: GitHub API verification failed. Host: {host}. Active gh account: {active}. Repository: {repository}. Verification: `gh api repos/{repository} --jq .permissions` → {summary}. Retry; then check the hostname, VPN, DNS, and GitHub availability. Do not inspect or share tokens, headers, or full response bodies. No mutation started.
gh_project_scope:
GitHub Board setup needs the write-capable `project` scope. Host: {host}. Active gh account: {active}. Safe scope status: {scopeStatus}. Project owner: {owner}{project}. Result: {summary}. Run:
`gh auth refresh -h github.com -s project`
then
`gh auth status --hostname github.com`
The refresh uses GitHub's browser/device flow. No token is requested. No mutation started.
gh_project_access: GitHub Project access failed. Host: {host}. Active gh account: {active}. Project owner: {owner}{project}. Result: {summary}. For 403, ask a Project owner/admin to grant this account write access and confirm organization policies permit Projects. For 404, verify the derived owner, Project number, visibility, and that the account can see the owner's private Project. Check with `gh project list --owner {owner} --limit 100 --format json`. Check host/VPN/DNS for network failures. No mutation started.
gh_project_write_access: GitHub Project write access could not be verified. Host: {host}. Active gh account: {active}. Project owner: {owner}{project}. Result: {summary}. A 403 requires Project write rights and compatible organization policy; a 404 means the Project or owner is not visible to this account. Confirm with `gh project view {number} --owner {owner}`. Ask a Project owner/admin to grant access. No mutation started.
